version.value: Abridged solo-piano performance by the composer
version.note: The complete 1903 disc is streamed, not a digitally assembled excerpt. Its approximately two-minute duration is not the complete score. Comparison alignment excludes the shortened ending and music found only in Vetter’s complete reading.

date.note: Commons identifies 1903 in the description; its 10 March 2012 Date field is the upload date.

catalogue.note: IMSLP lists No. 3800; Marston lists 35515. The exact pressing used for the Commons transfer is not identified.

matrixTakeSides.note: No take suffix is supplied by these sources.

credits.note: The uploader is not identified as the transfer engineer. The Commons description “Original tape” does not establish the 1903 medium or a transfer chain.

date.note: 10 March 2012 is the upload date, not a demonstrated transfer date.

processing.note: The Commons transfer’s restoration and replay speed are not documented. Marston discusses pitch instability in these early discs, but its modern restoration is not the audio streamed here.

digital.format: MP3 access derivative; one source file, no concatenation or audio edits by Contrapunctus

composition.value: Underlying piano composition is public domain under ordinary life-plus-70 terms
composition.note: Grieg died in 1907. This does not establish rights in a modern edition.

recording.value: US public domain: sound recording first published in 1903
recording.note: IMSLP’s recording entry names Gramophone & Typewriter No. 3800, 1903, matrix 2149F; Marston corroborates matrix, pianist and 2 May 1903 session. The recording’s pre-1926 publication, not Commons’ composition-only PD-old tag, is the basis. No non-commercial restriction appears in the inspected source entry.

rights.creditLine: Edvard Grieg, Wedding Day at Troldhaugen, Op. 65 No. 6; Edvard Grieg, piano. Paris, 2 May 1903; Gramophone & Typewriter matrix 2149F, published 1903. Abridged performance; transfer engineer unknown; via Wikimedia Commons. Sound recording: US public domain.
